Decision card: needs_decision fork review (project review thread 「#25251 披露口径裁决」) · letters A / B / C · recommends **B** · maintainer 「对于这种类似的问题，能否你自己开一个单独的 fable thread 做评审，对于自己有把握决定的问题，自己决定，不能决定的开决策卡？」 2026-10-22T19:41Z

Reviewed by ruling session `session_01K89MJzkZf3kKA7pY3ECfWH` (project thread https://claude.ai/code/project/chan_01D5bWFY3rFzgJcytD5gD4Uu?thread=cmsg_01D5bWFY3rFzgJcytD5gD4UuYJtf7LmCbKh7net8LXW4cR), opened by the `domain:services` seat 1 project when this card reached dispatch. **Marker: needs-user-decision (not auto-adjudicated).** The fix direction narrows a published contract (`FlowSchema.runAs` says a system flow keeps system privileges) and chooses between product capabilities, so under the confidence gate (SKILL.md 〈升级与决策〉; `triage-duties.md` ①–③, floors 已发布契约语义 / 产品能力取舍) it is the maintainer's letter, not this thread's. State: `pm:queue` → `needs-user-decision` in the same act. ⛔ Nothing below is a reproduction; the recipe stays on objectstack-ai/cloud#3149 per the disclosure rule quoted under Governing text.

## 维护者速读

一句话问题:环境管理员写的 `runAs: 'system'` 流程,给别人分配岗位(含满权限岗位)、直接写邀请行时,不经过 ADR-0090 D12 委托管理门,行上也没有 `granted_by`;这是按 ADR-0073「system = god-mode」的设计,还是要像 2026-10-03 对 `sys_metadata` 那样,把「应用作者写的自动化」从 system 提权里再切出一块?

- 可达读数(卡里「Not measured」项,本线程按代码读出):流程定义只有 `manage_metadata` 持有者能建/改/克隆(`packages/runtime/src/domains/automation.ts:380`),`manage_metadata` 是 `scope: 'platform'`、构成 `PLATFORM_ADMIN` 档的平台专属能力(`capabilities.ts:43`、`tenant-layer0-verdict.ts:90-93`),围墙姿态下更只剩平台运营方(ADR-0131 D3,#23231 裁 A)。所以作者就是环境最高管理员,D12 本来就允许他「assigns any set to anyone」;实际缺口是**审计留痕**(无 `granted_by`)与**邀请门检查被跳过**,不是越权。
- 只按可达定级,本卡至多 p3(filing-gate「仅最高权限可达且无现用者至多 p3」);若选 B(改 spec 声明面)则按「协议类恒 p1」走。字母决定档位。
- 推荐 **B**:与 #21520 裁 A / #21654 同形——应用作者写的流程即使 `runAs: 'system'` 也不碰受治理的身份分配表,响亮拒绝并给处方;平台 seeder / better-auth 路径不动。

## Governing text

- `packages/spec/src/automation/flow.zod.ts:1163` (`FlowSchema.runAs` describe, the published contract): "system = elevated (bypasses RLS) — system flows keep system privileges". Re-check: `grep -n "system flows keep system privileges" packages/spec/src/automation/flow.zod.ts` → 1 hit.
- `docs/adr/0073-automation-execution-identity.md` Amendment (2026-07-28, #3760): "The security middleware's `isSystem` short-circuit precedes its package-managed-row / system-row / audience-anchor / delegated-admin gates, all of which a principal-less context still has to clear — so "unscoped" was never equivalent to "system", and elevating would have *widened* these runs (e.g. letting them write `sys_user_position`) rather than preserving the status quo." and M2: "`runAs:'system'` stays god-mode throughout." Re-check: `grep -n "stays god-mode throughout" docs/adr/0073-automation-execution-identity.md` → 1 hit.
- `docs/adr/0096-execution-surface-identity-admission.md:56`: "| Flow (`runAs:'system'`) | explicit elevation | ADR-0049/#1888, by design |".
- `packages/plugins/plugin-security/src/delegated-admin-gate.ts` header: "System/boot writes carry `isSystem` and short-circuit the security middleware before this gate (seeders, publish materializer, better-auth reconciliation are unaffected)."
- Precedent, the maintainer's one carve-out of authored-flow reach from system elevation: `packages/spec/src/kernel/stored-metadata-body-objects.ts:74-78` `STORED_METADATA_BODY_PRESCRIPTION`: "Elevation (`runAs`, a system context) does not change this."; its D3 entry `18.flow-write-node-stored-metadata-target-refused.ts`: "The maintainer ruled (2026-10-03) that app-authored work may not write those tables: the metadata protocol is their only writer … and a flow is app-authored automation." Re-check: `grep -rn "a flow is app-authored automation" packages/spec/src/migrations/entries/semantic/` → 1 hit.
- `.claude/skills/pm-dispatch/references/lanes/services.md`: 「安全与权限边界的放宽是人工地板,恒升级不代裁。」「安全族卡的披露纪律:复现配方不落任何公开面(卡、PR、评论)。证据以抽象描述或私有通道承载。」
- `.claude/skills/pm-dispatch/references/filing-gate.md`: 「可达面定上界:`security` 标签不抬级;仅最高权限可达且无现用者至多 p3,可记录不修。」「协议类:修复改 spec 接受/声明面 … 此类任何车道皆 p1 + 在研大版 `target:` … 维护者裁决,本节余条不压。」
- Disclosure, maintainer ruling 2026-08-18 on #9387 (`docs/qa/platform-checklist/RUNNER.md:80-91`): "Never publish a reproduction for an authentication or authorization hole anywhere on GitHub … Existence published, recipe withheld, is a complete and actionable report".

**Is the protocol changed?** Letters A and B narrow what `FlowSchema.runAs` declares, so each is 协议类 (one describe sentence + an ADR-0087 semantic entry in `packages/spec`, `domain:spec`, `Clause-②: yes (narrowing)`); letter C changes no declaration.

## Premises (each with its re-check; read on `origin/main` 2069b81 / HEAD 72fad92)

1. The system short-circuit precedes the gate: `grep -n "if (opCtx.context?.isSystem)" packages/plugins/plugin-security/src/security-plugin.ts` → line 2613 returns `next()`; `delegatedAdminGate.assert` sits below it.
2. A `runAs: 'system'` run's data context is `{ isSystem: true, actor: 'svc:flow:<name>', flowRunId, userId? }`: `grep -n "svc:flow:" packages/services/service-automation/src/runtime-identity.ts` → 1 hit (~line 270). `flowRunId` is provenance, never a principal (`packages/spec/src/kernel/execution-context.zod.ts:400-411`), so the gate CAN tell a flow-origin system context from a seeder's without a new key.
3. Flow authoring requires `manage_metadata`: `grep -n "FLOW_AUTHORING_CAPABILITY" packages/runtime/src/domains/automation.ts` → `= 'manage_metadata'` at 380; `/meta` save doors the same (`packages/rest/src/meta-collection-routes.ts:452`).
4. `manage_metadata` is platform-exclusive: `grep -n "name: 'manage_metadata'" packages/spec/src/security/capabilities.ts` → `scope: 'platform'`; `grep -n "PLATFORM_ADMIN_ONLY_CAPABILITIES" packages/plugins/plugin-security/src/security-plugin.ts` → lists it; `organization_admin` withholds it by design (`default-permission-sets.ts:341`).
5. `granted_by` is stamped only on admitted NON-system writes: `grep -n "Stamp the writer into" packages/plugins/plugin-security/src/delegated-admin-gate.ts` → line 199.
6. Blind spot, not measured: a hand-authored set carrying `manage_metadata` without the `*` superuser bit is `PLATFORM_ADMIN` for Layer 0 but not "tenant-level" for D12 (gate header's definition), so such a holder could reach assignment rows through a system flow that it cannot write directly. No built-in set has that shape (`default-permission-sets.ts`), so it is a residual, not the measured case.

## Options × real cost × effort

| 选项 | 做什么 | 客户可感知后果 | 工作量 |
|:--|:--|:--|:--|
| **A** 按作者判 | D12 门也跑在「源自流程元数据」的 system 上下文上,以流程作者/owner 为被判主体 | 管理员写的流程照常生效;作者权限不够时流程失败(运行期才知道);需要把「作者身份」带进运行上下文——新的判定模式 | services + spec(ExecutionContext 加作者位 + runAs 声明);无同形先例;比 B 大 |
| **B** 拒绝(推荐) | 源自流程元数据的 system 上下文(`isSystem` 且带 `flowRunId`)写 `sys_user_position` / `sys_user_permission_set` / `sys_invitation` / `sys_member` 一律 `PERMISSION_DENIED` + 处方:改 `runAs: 'user'` 让 D12 门按操作人判,邀请走邀请门;seeder / better-auth / 系统服务(无 `flowRunId`)不动 | 想用 system 流程自动分配岗位的管理员收到响亮拒绝和处方;没有静默分支 | services 运行期一 PR(先例 #21649:+465/−4,4 files)+ spec 声明一 PR(先例 #21687:+658/−23,13 files,`Clause-②: yes (narrowing)`);两 PR 顺序同 #21624→#21654 |
| **C** 记录不修 | 维持 ADR-0073「god-mode throughout」;可达仅最高权限 ⇒ 降 p3;只补留痕:system 流程写入时把流程 actor 打进 `granted_by` | 行为不变;审计能看到是哪条流程给的;邀请门检查仍被跳过 | services 一 S/M PR;无先例,改动在 `delegated-admin-gate.ts` 的 stamp 分支;0 spec |

业务含义直译:A = 「自动化以写它的人的身份管人」;B = 「人事/权限分配这类治理动作,自动化不准以超级身份做,要么以操作人身份走门,要么走邀请流程」(参照:Salesforce 把权限集分配等 Setup 对象与业务数据的 system-mode 旁路分开治理);C = 「超级管理员写的脚本本来就是超级权限,记清楚是谁就行」。

## 四维分析(从业务立场)

① **项目长远合理性(≥50%)**:两年后的平台样子是 ADR-0073 D2——应用自动化以 `automation` 主体、RLS 受约束地跑,`system` 是平台代码的提权,不是应用作者的常态。维护者 2026-10-03 已经为元数据表切过一次「应用作者写的流程 ≠ 平台代码,提权不改变这一点」(#21520 A → #21624/#21654)。身份分配表是另一组有自己门的受治理表(D12 门、邀请门)。B 把这条规则从一张表扩到同族,是**一条规则覆盖全族**,缩小特例;A 新增一种判定模式(以作者为主体),是契约增生;C 把已知的留痕缺口留在平台上。只看①选 B。
② **实际业务拉动**:今天撞上的是 cloud 的实测(cloud#3149 第 5 项),不是客户投诉;没有量到任何依赖「system 流程分配岗位」的生产流程(本仓、examples、skills、docs 对身份表的写节点未做普查——执行时先做,同 #21649 的 census 段)。零拉动的能力默认 remove,与 B 同向;C 的留痕是真实审计需求,B 顺带满足(拒绝后不存在无 `granted_by` 的行)。
③ **防 AI 犯错**:AI 写元数据 app 最容易的错就是「不会就 `runAs: 'system'`」(ADR-0138 D2b 已为此拒过一次匿名门)。B 让这种流程在碰身份表时**响亮拒绝并给处方**;A 在作者是管理员时静默放行、作者不够时运行期才失败;C 静默成功。B 最优。
④ **创业阶段不扩散**:B 删能力不加键;A 加「作者主体」概念并永久维护;C 不动。④ 的「新增门禁默认否」:B 不是新门,是既有 D12 门的一条臂 + #21654 已立的「流程写受治理表拒绝」类的同族扩展;点名的维护者原话即上文 D3 entry 引文。不翻转。
自检行:只看①选 B;②③④ 是否翻转:否。

os-decision-facets
① 项目长远合理性:B 缩小特例——「应用作者的自动化不以提权碰受治理表」从元数据表扩到身份分配表,一条规则;A 扩大契约(新判定主体);C 留缺口。
② 实际业务拉动:零拉动(无生产流程依赖 system 流程分配岗位;实测来自 cloud 本地栈),默认 remove;审计留痕为真实需求。
③ 防 AI 犯错:B 响亮拒绝 + 处方;A 对管理员静默放行;C 静默成功。
④ 创业阶段不扩散:B 删能力不加键,非新门(既有 D12 门臂 + #21654 同族);A declare-and-maintain;C 维持。
Prior rulings read: runas,issystem,delegated-admin,sys_user_position,sys_invitation,elevation → 19 hits; ADR-0073 Amendment (2026-07-28) + ADR-0096 D5 table + ADR-0103 D2 + ADR-0090 D12 (amended 2026-10-17, 6228728551) + ADR-0131 D3 read; tool's top hit ADR-0058 D8 read, off-topic; thread: none; repo: objectstack-ai/objectstack

## Recommendation and confidence gaps

**B.** Not A: it mints a second judging principal (the author) that no ADR names, and it hides the failure until run time. Not C: it keeps a measured audit gap on a security table and leaves the invitation door's checks skippable, for a capability nobody was measured using. Gaps, stated and not used to change the letter: (i) no census yet of write nodes aimed at the four identity objects across the repo, examples, skills, docs and hotcrm (B's PR does it first, as #21649 did; a non-zero count is reported, not worked around); (ii) premise 6's residual shape is unmeasured; (iii) `sys_user_permission_set` is added to the card's three objects because the gate governs it beside `sys_user_position` (gate header) — the maintainer may strike it.

## Execution after the letter (so the maintainer rules direction only)

- **B** → priority stays `priority:p1` (协议类), two PRs in order, `mode:thread`, effort xhigh, services seat 1 dispatches: PR1 `domain:services` run-time arm in `plugin-security` (refuse when `context.isSystem && context.flowRunId` and the object is one of the four; `PERMISSION_DENIED`; prescription names `runAs: 'user'` and the invitation door; seeders unaffected; pins for refused / seeder-control / `runAs: 'user'`-judged-by-D12 cases; ablation; census first; disclosure rule: pins describe the behaviour, no recipe). PR2 `domain:spec` (one sentence on the `runAs` describe + ADR-0087 D3 semantic entry, `Clause-②: yes (narrowing)`), filed as a hand-off comment on the spec seat since this project does not hold `domain:spec`. The card parks `pm:blocked` + `Blocked-by:` on PR2's card after PR1 lands, as #21624 did.
- **A** → one services PR plus the spec `ExecutionContext` key and `runAs` sentence; the maintainer names which identity is "the author" (creator vs last editor) in the same word.
- **C** → relabel `priority:p3`, one S/M services PR stamping the flow actor into `granted_by` on the system path; the card closes on it.
- **Any letter**: dispatch as a `security` card thread (SKILL.md: 席位是项目线程时 `security` 一律 `thread`); the reproduction stays on cloud#3149 and off every public surface.

Related: cloud#3149 (private; the measurement), #21520 / #21624 / #21654 (the precedent carve-out, PRs #21649 and #21687), #23960 (D12 amendment, 6228728551), #9387 (disclosure ruling), ADR-0073, ADR-0090 D12, ADR-0096, ADR-0103 D2, ADR-0131 D3.
